title: Openness of a fixed projective-dimension bound
statement: Let R be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], M a finite R-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and n a natural number. The set of primes p of R such that Ext^i_{R_p}(M_p,N) vanishes for every R_p-module N and every i ≥ n+1 [def-pc-ext] is open in Spec R. In Lean this is the locus of HasProjectiveDimensionLE (M.localizedModule p.primeCompl) n. This includes n = 0 and M = 0.

source.place: Tag 00NX, finite projective modules and local freeness; dimension shifting applied to finite free presentations; More on Algebra, Tag 068V; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00NX

proof.text: Induct on n, generalizing M. For n = 0 use projective_iff_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_zero and IsProjective.iff_projective. Identify the categorical localized module (a Shrink model) with the usual localized module using Module.mem_freeLocus_of_isLocalization and localizedModuleMkLinearMap. A finite projective module over a local ring is free by Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing, and a free module is projective. Thus the locus is Module.freeLocus R M. Finite modules over a Noetherian ring are finitely presented, and Module.isOpen_freeLocus makes this locus open.

source.place: Tag 00NX, finite projective modules and local freeness; dimension shifting applied to finite free presentations; More on Algebra, Tag 068V; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00NX

proof.text: For n + 1 take Module.exists_finite_presentation R M, with finite projective middle module P and surjection f onto M. Its kernel is finite by Noetherianity. Form f.shortComplexKer and localize it at each prime. Exactness is preserved by localizedModuleFunctor, as is projectivity of P. Apply ShortComplex.ShortExact.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₃_iff to identify the locus of bound n + 1 for M with the locus of bound n for the kernel. Apply the induction hypothesis to the kernel. These are the exact steps of the delivered Lean proof.

lean.statement:
theorem isOpen_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_locus
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Finite R M] (n : ℕ) :
    IsOpen {p : PrimeSpectrum R |
      HasProjectiveDimensionLE (M.localizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl) n}
